validation.terminal_evidence: Reported by owner/root; reviewer read exact source/log without rebuilding.

checked: Pure/classify/opcode match the selected arithmetic/environment/control families; classify_sound proves any successful classification identifies the original opcode. Unsupported memory/storage/log/terminal operations classify to none.

familyAction computes literal results from input view and instruction, never supplied postconditions; size retains checked UInt256 length, nonzero PUSH checks width, taken jumps check pinned source jump membership, zero JUMPI bypasses destination check.
DUP selects head index depth-1; SWAP selects tail index depth-1 and replaces that selected slot with old top, preserving intervening and subsequent elements.
related_advance preserves every other running-view field and proves natural PC addition under explicit fit; related_jump uses actual word destination natural value without a terminal-PC claim.
raw_dispatch identifies the actual accepted intermediate as zMid and executes the raw instruction on stepPre cost zMid, preserving resource-independent whole-view relation.
binary derives two actual operands from accepted Z, uses literal reference arithmetic parity on the same charged state, and identifies supplied post via functional result injectivity.
binary derives PC fit from actual runtime At/decoded opcode, not an externally supplied no-wrap predicate; source action equality consumes the original related stack and actual operand shape.

raw_dispatch: actual StepOk(fuel+1) for matching Pure opcode

limits: Only binary family execution transport is proved in this foundation; environment/control family consumers are separate.

Action is a source-shaped operation vocabulary, not full Python operational semantics or failure-equivalence proof. Gas, static/stack-capacity admission and caller/value/byte binding require their accepted-step/source adapters.
related_advance is a reusable local lemma with explicit PC fit; binary discharges that fit internally.
